# AAA Northeast relocating Union office to West Branch Commons


September 2, 2026 NJ Biz


Body


AAA Northeast is relocating its[Union](https://njbiz.com/tag/union/) office to another spot in the township.


After signing a lease for a 3,510-square-foot space at[West Branch Commons](https://njbiz.com/tag/west-branch-commons/) , the regional motor club expects to open soon, according to shopping center owner[Urban Edge Properties](https://njbiz.com/tag/urban-edge-properties/) .


Read the full article[here](https://njbiz.com/aaa-northeast-relocating-union-office-to-west-branch-commons/) .
